q0AnchorReason: Reads no q0. Roots of unity and Galois degrees at the degree-2 place of K = Q(alpha); the substrate modulus never enters.
source: CGZ arXiv:1712.04887v3 Theorem 1.2, Proposition 2.5; Addenda 32, 37 (this repo)

result.verdict: v_2 confirmed vacuous, and for two independent reasons. The Addendum-32 reason (mu_3 already present, so Gal is trivial and the eigenspace is the whole group) is measured. A second reason it did not have: w_F = 24 at v_2, so gcd(n, w_F) = 3 > 1, Theorem 1.2 does not apply, and R^{w_F} = R^24 = 1 identically in a group of exponent 3 -- the same mechanism that makes m = 2 vacuous everywhere. The contrast control at v_1 (w_F = 4, gcd = 1, R^{w_F} non-trivial) shows the test discriminates between the places rather than always reporting vacuous.

scope: scope-(a) CONFIRMATION, not a discovery. Addendum 32 predicted the degree-2 place carries no eps_m invariant but never measured it; given how many inferences in this arc failed when measured, the prediction was checked. It holds -- and a SECOND, independent reason turns up that the eigenspace argument does not give: at v_2 the local field is Q_25 with w_F = 24, so gcd(3, w_F) = 3 > 1, Theorem 1.2 does not apply, and Prop 2.5 defines only R^{w_F} = R^24 = 1 identically in a group of exponent 3 -- the same mechanism that makes m = 2 vacuous in every field. That is stronger than the eigenspace reason: even granting a descent there is no non-trivial power to read. Contrast control at v_1 (w_F = 4, gcd = 1, eigenspace 3 of 9, R^{w_F} non-trivial) shows the test discriminates between places. No value changes. Nothing wired.
